comparison_reference.name: Sprout Lands Asset Pack by Cup Nooble
comparison_reference.notes: Published farming asset pack describes simple character animations and, in its premium pack, six animation types in four directions; comparison is limited to published description, not a direct visual inspection of its downloadable sprites.

professional_quality.evidence: Two character designs have clear outfits, but repeated poses and tiny tool shapes lack the finish of a complete commercial character pack.
professional_quality.guidance: Compare finish against a named professional reference; explain remaining weaknesses.

readability.evidence: Both figures and four directions are recognizable at native size; the side views compress facial features.
readability.guidance: Identify each subject at native resolution from silhouette and proportions.

pixel_clustering.evidence: At 3x the large color blocks are mostly clean, but the tool heads become tiny angular clusters.
pixel_clustering.guidance: Inspect clusters for noise, isolated pixels, banding and accidental geometry.

color_and_lighting.evidence: Hair, clothing and skin have coherent ramps, though the darker outlines are heavy.
color_and_lighting.guidance: Check palette harmony, volume, light direction and controlled contrast.

materials.evidence: Fabric and hair separate by color; the small tool heads do not establish a clear metal surface.
materials.guidance: Explain how each material reads through its structure rather than generic pattern noise.

specialized_design.evidence: Four directions and tool poses are present, but arm and tool movement is limited and anatomy is simplified.
specialized_design.guidance: Check anatomy, architecture and characteristic features of the subject.

artistic_detail.evidence: Clothing collars and apron straps add character; small versions lose these distinctions.
artistic_detail.guidance: Assess depth, personality and finish beyond a merely acceptable primitive.

originality.evidence: The two outfits and hair silhouettes differ, but independence from prior character work is not established.
originality.guidance: Compare with prior and rejected work; explain new geometry and legitimate reuse.

consistency.evidence: Repeated views share proportions; two scales coexist on one sheet without documented use.
consistency.guidance: Compare scale, perspective, style and detail density within the intended catalog.

technical_integrity.evidence: The 1024 by 768 transparent image has 192 islands, 37 colors, no singleton pixels and at least 2 px canvas margin; per-cell clipping was not verified.
technical_integrity.guidance: Verify dimensions, transparency, borders, directions and absence of deformation.

game_readiness.evidence: A static atlas depicts poses, but frame timing, sequences, pivots, extraction and runtime behavior have not been verified.
game_readiness.guidance: Verify complete views/states/animations and integration without manual repair.
